parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for reaching out—happy to get this routed to our privacy/compliance contact.

To make sure your legal team’s questions are answered accurately, could you please share the following?
1) Which DPA document/version is being reviewed (or a link/name).
2) The requesting legal entity/customer name (so we can align the response to the correct agreement).
3) Whether you have any current or proposed practices for support logging/retention that you want us to confirm (e.g., what fields may appear in logs and retention duration).
4) Any specificity on “customer identifiers” for support logs (for example: account IDs, customer emails, IP addresses, usernames, or free-text contents).

Once we have that, we’ll route your request to the appropriate privacy contact for confirmation on:
- subprocessors,
- data retention, and
- whether/when support logs may include customer identifiers.

If you have a preferred deadline for the review, please include it as well (you can share the date/time).
promised_actions: Route the request to the appropriate privacy/compliance contact for review.
Provide a follow-up once the privacy contact has reviewed the subprocessors, data retention, and support-log/customer-identifier questions.
safety_notes: Avoid promising specific DPA language or legal conclusions.
Acknowledge escalation/human review requirement without claiming resolution.
